name: Carpet for Rentals: What Landlords Should Actually Buy
title-tag: Rental Property Carpet: What Landlords Should Buy
meta-description: The rental carpet spec that wins the turnover math: solution-dyed fiber, mid-grade pad, flecked neutral. Cost per tenant-year, and when to clean vs replace.
post-summary: February 18, 2027 · The right rental carpet is solution-dyed fiber in a flecked neutral over a mid-grade pad — bought on cost per tenant-year, not price per square foot. The spec line by line, why cheap pad is what actually kills rental carpet, the clean-patch-replace triage at turnover, and where carpet belongs in a rental at all.
